---
title: "Check the practice inputs"
---


Check that the count-table sample names match metadata IDs and the feature IDs match taxonomy. Confirm that the group labels are Group A and Group B.

The analysis runs these checks automatically. Use the [practice command](../../01-run-the-workflow.qmd#practice) and resolve any reported error before inspecting results.
